name: Sigulda Open 2017

venue.name: [Sigulda youth center](https://www.sigulda.lv/public/lat/izglitiba/interesu_izglitiba/jaunrades_centrs1/jaunrades_centra_strukturvienibas/)
venue.details: Signs to the competition place will be at the venue.

information:
Sigulda Open will be the first competition for a long time outside of Riga.
Competition will be held on the 11th of February in Sigulda. 5 disciplines where you can take part yourself or see Latvian best speedcubers. 

The event takes place for 1 days and the participation cost is 5 EUR..
